headline: Denée Benton and Patina Miller Help Give ‘School Girls’ a Broadway Glow-Up
context: Jocelyn Bioh’s breakthrough 2017 play about cliques and colorism is just as funny — and devastating — with a sharp ensemble and direction by Whitney White.
